guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) He asked me whether I would join the company. (b) Had I the wings of a dove I would fly here and there in the sky. (c) He could help you provided that you did the job successfully. (d) Hardly had the bell rung when the students went out from the classrooms. (e) We must look before we leap lest we should fall in danger.
